## Price for a group of 40+1

Price per person in USD, first group. The original offer calls the package “Package: 5* Hotels + Services”. 40 participants + 1 FOC means one free place.

| Package | SGL — single occupancy | DBL — double occupancy |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 5* Hotels + Services | $7140 | $4640 |

Specific hotels and arrival dates are not stated. The general exclusions list excludes accommodation unless it is quoted separately in the offer. The hotel package is therefore confirmed when you book. Domestic and international flights are charged separately.

## Meals and themed dinners

In addition to the meals listed in the daily programme, the overall inclusions cover dinner at the hotel in Rio, lunch during the Corcovado and Santa Teresa tour, Theme Party 1 at the hotel in Rio, lunch and dinner at the hotel in Foz do Iguaçu, and Theme Party 2 at the hotel in Foz do Iguaçu. These services are retained in the full list of included meals. Their schedule and format are confirmed when you book. Drinks are not included.
